notice: [SAMPLE DEMO DATASET] Synthetic CAG Compliance & Performance Audit paragraphs modeled on cag.gov.in and APMS ATN tracking schemas. All report numbers and para figures are illustrative demo placeholders.

records.report_no: CAG Union Compliance Report No. 12 of 2024 (Demo)
records.ministry_name: Ministry of Ports & Inland Waterways — Demo
records.title: Unfruitful expenditure on unutilized dredging terminal equipment
records.summary_text: Dredging barges and terminal moorings procured at a cost of INR 64.50 crore remained uncommissioned for 30 months due to pending environmental and land-handover clearances. Similar planning gaps were also observed in the preceding audit cycle.

records.report_no: CAG State Performance Report No. 4 of 2024 (Demo)
records.ministry_name: State Directorate of Health Services — Demo
records.title: Idle outlay on district diagnostic laboratories lacking specialist staffing
records.summary_text: High-value diagnostic analyzers worth INR 28.40 crore installed across 14 district hospitals remained largely idle across three consecutive audit review periods due to non-commissioning of reagent supply contracts and technician vacancies.

records.report_no: CAG Union Compliance Report No. 18 of 2024 (Demo)
records.title: Non-recovery of contractual liquidated damages on delayed optical fibre rollout
records.summary_text: Contractual liquidated damages quantified at INR 12.20 crore for milestone delays exceeding 18 months were not recovered from running bills prior to partial bank-guarantee release.

records.report_no: CAG Union Compliance Report No. 12 of 2024 (Demo)
records.title: Reconciled utilization certificates for state seed-testing grants
records.summary_text: Following audit observation on INR 4.80 crore of pending utilization certificates, the Ministry furnished reconciled vouchers verified by the State Accountant General; ATN vetted and settled.

records.report_no: CAG Union Compliance Report No. 18 of 2024 (Demo)
records.ministry_name: Ministry of Renewable Energy Grants — Demo
records.title: Dropped para following full recovery of excess subsidy advance
records.summary_text: Excess subsidy disbursement of INR 9.10 crore identified during audit was recovered in full with interest into the Consolidated Fund of India; audit paragraph dropped.
